title: The State of Data Curation at NeurIPS: An Assessment of Dataset Development Practices in the Datasets and Benchmarks Track
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The results indicate a general need for better documentation practices for machine learning datasets, especially concerning environmental footprint, ethical considerations (in a broad sense), and data management.
